tagline: 尼康数码单反相机，2009 年发布
description: 尼康于2009年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable, Nikon F-mount。快门速度30 s to 1/8000 s in 1/2 or 1/3 stops and Bulb, 1/250 s X-sync, 1/320 s X-sync with Nikon SB-600/800/900.。

specs.传感器: 23.6 mm × 15.8 mm Nikon DX format RGB CMOS sensor, 1.5 × FOV crop, 5.50µm pixel size
specs.快门速度: 30 s to 1/8000 s in 1/2 or 1/3 stops and Bulb, 1/250 s X-sync, 1/320 s X-sync with Nikon SB-600/800/900.
specs.曝光测光: TTL 3D Color Matrix Metering II metering with a 1005-pixel RGB sensor
specs.闪光灯: Built in Pop-up, Guide number 13m at ISO 100, Standard ISO hotshoe, Compatible with the Nikon Creative Lighting System
specs.存储: CompactFlash (Type I) and Secure Digital, SDHC compatible
specs.重量: Approx. without battery, memory card or body cap
